scope: Three focused Caster revisions, original master versions preserved

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one BRAND NEW original EXACTLY SQUARE hand-painted fantasy strategy ability icon for Idlever. Style reference image only: bold angular anatomy, expressive hands and brows, thick gouache/oil paint planes, visible broad brushstrokes, dark navy/blue-violet shadows, warm ivory highlights, restrained crimson and worn gold. Classic RTS ability-painting personality. Original art, no copied game assets. This is a tiny24px icon: ONE large gesture occupying85percent of the square, only3value masses, bright focal shape covering at leastone-third. No realistic pores, fibres, tiny scenery, photographic rendering, bloom haze, intricate glyphs, vector pictogram, text, frame, border, UI or signature. Opaque near-black painted background with strong clean negative space. CHILLING CHARGE: an enormous bare angular sorcerer's hand thrusts forward from a crimson cuff, index and middle fingers held together in a forceful casting gesture. A single bright ivory-blue zigzag frozen BOLT wraps around these two fingers and hooks toward upper right, with just TWO large ice facets. Cropped sly sorcerer's brow and one eye in the upper-left corner are secondary. Fingers and bolt form one clear diagonal lightning silhouette. Convey cold power being channelled back into protection; avoid the dark staff-and-orb composition of the older draft. No staff, shield, full person, scenery or many small sparks.
